build_erfnet_backbone: build an ERFNet backbone model for real-time semantic segmentation with configurable encoder and decoder
create_downsampler_block: create a DownsamplerBlock that concatenates conv and max pool outputs before batch normalization
create_nonbottleneck1d_block: create a NonBottleneck1d block with asymmetric convolutions and residual connections for feature extraction
create_upsampler_block: create an UpsamplerBlock using transposed convolution for upsampling features in the decoder
test_erfnet_forward: test the ERFNet forward pass by passing an input tensor through encoder and decoder stages
